title: Commander Advice Global Manifest
description: The one global manifest over all of the commander's advice: one row per conceptual unit of infrastructure, each a sub-directory with its own manifest (commander-advice-unit) that reads every CA on that unit. CA numbering is global and never reused across units. Filed at commander/advice/MANIFEST-advice.json.

kind.description: the words commander-advice-units, which is what chooses this schema

version.description: a number bumped when the global manifest's shape changes, so a reader can tell an old copy from a new one

updated.description: the date this manifest was last brought level with the unit manifests, YYYY-MM-DD

convention.description: one line on how the advice units as a whole are kept, for a reader who has never opened them

units.description: one row per conceptual unit of infrastructure

items.description: one unit: its name and the path to its own manifest

unit.description: the unit's name, matching the sub-directory it sits in

path.description: where the unit's own manifest sits, relative to this manifest

status.description: active while the unit is in use, retired once it becomes wholly no longer relevant
